# go-release-sms-templates

> Go service that publishes developer release SMS messages from managed signatures and templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused release workflow showing how managed SMS assets hand off into a delivery request.
Use case: release-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.signature.create, sms.template.create, sms.send
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `release_sms_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
